verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents guarded rollouts that automatically increase traffic while monitoring metrics for regressions, which is a built-in event/metric-driven automated action. The pack also lists an 'Adaptive triggers' docs section, but only by title, so its rule-definition depth is unevidenced. Targeting rules, scheduled changes and webhooks are evaluation logic, time-based scheduling and outbound notifications, not user-defined event-to-action rules, so they are not credited. missing for 10: documented user-definable trigger conditions and actions, detail on what events can fire triggers (e.g. external monitoring alerts), explicit automatic rollback/remediation behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions
